changelog: **Fix (a11y):** in dark mode a hovered `hover:text-blue-800` link fell through to the accent remap (`accent-800`, dark text on a dark card). The profile-progress chips on `/portal/profile` hovered to `rgb(30,64,175)` on gray-900, which turned the full-suite `a11y-scan` red. `hover:text-blue-800` now joins the dark accent hover list and reads `accent-300`.

en: In dark mode, the missing-field links on your profile stay readable when you hover them.
tr: Koyu temada profilindeki eksik alan bağlantıları, üzerine gelince de okunur kalıyor.
de: Im Dunkelmodus bleiben die Links zu fehlenden Profilfeldern auch beim Überfahren lesbar.
